Class ErrorUtilsTest

@IsTest()
private class ErrorUtilsTest

Test class for ErrorUtils. Validates error logging functionality including fluent API usage, exception handling, database error capture, Flow integration via invocable methods, and platform event publishing for real-time error monitoring.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void createAuraHandledExceptionTest()

Tests the createAuraHandledException() factory method. Verifies that the returned AuraHandledException preserves the provided message via getMessage().

Since:
    03/21/2026

@IsTest
private static void getErrorMessageTest()

Tests the getErrorMessage utility method for Database.Error arrays. Intentionally causes a database validation error (STRING_TOO_LONG) and verifies that the getErrorMessage method correctly formats the database error details including status code, error message, and affected field names.

@IsTest
private static void getExceptionMessageTest()

Tests the getExceptionMessage utility method. Intentionally causes a MathException (division by zero) and verifies that the getExceptionMessage method correctly formats the exception details into a readable message including exception type, message, line number, and stack trace.

@IsTest
private static void logTest1()

Tests the creation of an error log using the fluent API with a simple message. Verifies that the error log is saved correctly to the database with the specified code, message, module, and type.

@IsTest
private static void logTest2()

Tests the creation of an error log from an Exception object. Intentionally causes a MathException (division by zero) and verifies that the error log captures the exception details correctly including the exception type and message.

@IsTest
private static void logTest3()

Tests the creation of an error log from Database.Error array. Intentionally causes a database validation error (STRING_TOO_LONG) by attempting to insert an Account with an ExternalId that exceeds the field's maximum length. Verifies that the error log captures database error details including error code, field names, and status code.

@IsTest
private static void logTest4()

Tests the creation of an error log via the invocable method designed for Flow integration. Creates a FlowError object with specific properties and verifies that the createErrorLog invocable method successfully creates an error log record and returns a success indicator.

@IsTest
private static void publishTest()

Tests the publish method for publishing error logs as platform events. Creates an error log using the fluent API and publishes it as a platform event instead of saving to the database. Verifies that the EventBus.publish operation returns a success indicator. Platform event publishing is used for asynchronous error handling and real-time monitoring scenarios.
